==Usage==
<b style="color:red">!! This template currently creates extra whitespace. Please do not use it until this issue is fixed. !!</b><br />
This template is used to create [[:Category:Stub templates|stub templates]].
<pre>
{{Stub_template
|id=
|image=
|type=
|category=
|noexpand={{{noexpand|}}}
}}
</pre>

Optionally, use {{param|noexpand}} with a non-empty value if you don't want to display "You can help Wookieepedia by expanding it.", which we recommend only in cases such as wrapping in {{Tl|Stub box}}.

Optionally, use {{param|related}} with a non-empty value to say the article is "related to" {{param|type}} rather than "about" {{param|type}}.
